record.notes: Approved by the Governor and chaptered on 28 Sep 2024 as Chapter 817, Statutes of 2024. It adds Title 15.2 (commencing with Section 3110) to Part 4 of Division 3 of the Civil Code; the posting duty is in Civil Code section 3111. The Governor's release of 29 Sep 2024 lists it among the 17 bills on generative AI that he had signed over the previous 30 days. Compliance required from 1 Jan 2026.

verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026 under the rule that level A needs the instrument's own text or an official register. Stored in this run: the Assembly Weekly History No. 9 of 30 Nov 2024, the last complete history of the 2023-24 second-year bills compiled under the Chief Clerk (clerk.assembly.ca.gov), the legislature's record of AB 2013, which gives the subject title 'Generative artificial intelligence: training data transparency', the Code title it adds and its approval and chaptering on 28 Sep 2024 as Chapter 817, Statutes of 2024; and again the Senate Judiciary Committee's analysis of AB 412 (hearing of 23 Jun 2026, sjud.senate.ca.gov), which describes Civil Code section 3111 as existing law, with the deadline of 1 Jan 2026 and systems released on or after 1 Jan 2022. Re-read: the Governor's release of 29 Sep 2024 (gov.ca.gov, copy of 17 Oct 2026). The title, date and status now rest on the Assembly's record. The statute's text on leginfo.legislature.ca.gov still refuses automated downloads (HTTP 403), so official_url stays the Governor's release and the summary rests on the committee's description of section 3111. The AB 412 analysis once calls the law the 'California AI Transparency Act', the name of SB 942 (US-CA-02); the record keeps the bill's subject title. date_in_force is the compliance deadline of section 3111; no stored file gives the statute's own effective date.

judgment.status_reasoning: The Assembly's history records 'Sep. 28—Approved by the Governor' and 'Chaptered by Secretary of State − Chapter 817, Statutes of 2024'. The Senate Judiciary analysis of June 2026 treats Civil Code section 3111 as existing law, with posting required on or before 1 Jan 2026; that date has passed (today 18 Oct 2026). No stored record shows a repeal. 'In force' stands.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published 2024-09-28 is the approval by the Governor and the chaptering, both on 28 Sep 2024 in the Assembly's record ('Sep. 28, 2024' in its table of chaptered bills). date_in_force 2026-01-01 is the compliance deadline in section 3111 as the committee describes it; the statute's own effective date is not in a stored file.
judgment.scope_reasoning: AI-specific state law on training-data transparency for generative AI; in scope with no note.
